Complete immunohistochemistry and supplementary pathology reports and have them reviewed by the clinical team.
partial_criteria_en: Left breast invasive cancer has been confirmed by core needle biopsy, but immunohistochemistry or supplementary pathology remains to be completed
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If subsequent review finds that the specimen is insufficient or the diagnosis is inconsistent, diagnostic evaluation needs to be repeated.

completion_criteria_en: Complete available final pathology and necessary lymph node pathology assessment.
Formulate a subsequent oncologic treatment plan based on complete results.
partial_criteria_en: Sentinel lymph node biopsy and the main surgery have been completed, but complete pathology and treatment planning supported by it have not yet been completed.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If pathology results are insufficient to support the current treatment plan, treatment relying on that plan should be suspended and reassessed

completion_criteria_en: The planned left breast local excisional surgery and sentinel lymph node biopsy have been completed.
The clinical team confirms that the local surgical stage has ended
partial_criteria_en: The documented left breast-conserving excision, quadrantectomy, and sentinel lymph-node biopsy have been completed, but subsequent adjuvant treatment has not yet been determined according to complete pathology.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If final pathology shows margin or other local treatment issues, reassess whether further local management is needed.

completion_criteria_en: The incision and drainage status are stable on review
Complete drainage-tube removal or establish a clear plan for return to the hospital for tube removal after criteria are met.
The patient received guidance on wound and drain management.
partial_criteria_en: The current incision is healing well and there is already a plan for discharge with the drain and drainage monitoring, but the drainage tube has not yet met removal criteria
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If fever, incision redness, swelling or exudate, drainage abnormalities, or unstable condition occurs, it cannot be managed with routine follow-up.

completion_criteria_en: Complete arrangements for discharge with the tube in place
Clarify daily drainage-volume recording, criteria for return visit for tube removal, and arrangements for pathology-result notification or follow-up visit
partial_criteria_en: Discharge with the drainage tube has been approved and drainage management and return-to-hospital criteria have been provided, but subsequent review of pathology results and oncology treatment follow-up remain to be completed
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If the patient cannot perform drainage management, cannot obtain a means of returning to the hospital, or develops unstable clinical manifestations, discharge safety should be reassessed.
